title: Product Manager
description:
Job Description: Product Manager/ Associate Product manager Position Overview: 
 We are seeking an experienced Product Manager with a proven track record in creating exceptional Digital products. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 4 years of direct experience as a Product Manager, with a total work experience of 6 years or more. The candidate should possess exceptional problem-solving skills and a strong ability to execute releases effectively. 
 Responsibilities: 
 Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from ideation to execution, for digital products. 
 Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, marketing, and sales to define product requirements and priorities. 
 Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and gather customer feedback to inform product decisions. 
 Develop and maintain product roadmaps, ensuring alignment with company goals and objectives. 
 Define and prioritize features based on business value and customer impact. 
 Work closely with UX/UI designers to create intuitive and engaging user experiences. 
 Drive product launches, including coordinating with stakeholders and managing timelines to ensure successful releases. 
 Monitor key performance metrics and use data-driven insights to iterate on product features and enhance user experience. 
 Act as a product evangelist, effectively communicating product vision, strategy, and roadmap to internal teams and stakeholders. 
 Stay informed about industry trends and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for innovation and growth. 
 Requirements: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA or equivalent experience is a plus. Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Product Manager, with a total work experience of 6 years or more. Proven track record of successfully launching and managing B2C digital products from conception to launch. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex challenges and find innovative solutions. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing demands and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Experience working in Agile development environments and familiarity with Agile methodologies. Proficiency in using product management tools such as Jira, Asana, or Trello. Strong analytical skills with the ability to analyze data, draw insights, and make data-driven decisions. Passion for technology and digital innovation, with a customer-centric mindset. 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience working in e-commerce, SaaS, or digital media industries. Familiarity with UX/UI design principles and methodologies. Experience with A/B testing, user research, and usability testing. Proven track record of driving revenue growth and achieving business objectives through product innovation. Experience managing and mentoring junior product management team members. If you meet the qualifications outlined above and are passionate about building innovative digital products, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Key Skills: Agile Methodology,user research,Product Management,A/B testing,Product Strategy,Gtm,Product Roadmap,Asana

description:
Job Title: NPD Head Power 
 Department: New Product Development (NPD) 
 Industry: Electronic Manufacturing (Power Electronics) 
 Location: Vasai / Goregaon 
 
 Job Summary: 
We are seeking an experienced NPD Head Power to lead the development of power electronics products. This role involves driving end-to-end product development, focusing on innovation, efficiency, reliability, and cost optimization of power solutions across various applications.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Lead end-to-end New Product Development (NPD) for power electronics products. Define and execute product strategy and roadmap for power solutions. Manage cross-functional collaboration with R&D, Design, Production, Quality, Procurement, and Sales teams. Drive development of products such as power supplies, SMPS, inverters, chargers, battery management systems (BMS), and converters.
